footer.privacyText1: MOTO GROUP respects client confidentiality across the United Arab Emirates, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and State of Qatar. Client telemetry, contact information, and test-ride concierge bookings are handled with sovereign data protection standards.
footer.privacyText2: Personal credentials submitted through VIP private lounge or test-ride inquiries are utilized strictly for authorized dealer correspondence and are never disclosed to unauthorized third parties.
footer.termsText1: All displayed manufacturer trademarks, motorcycle specifications, horsepower ratings, and dyno telemetry are published under official Middle East distribution agreements for Ducati, BMW Motorrad, Vespa, and Harley-Davidson.
footer.termsText2: Test rides and private VIP lounge bookings are subject to valid GCC motorcycle licensing verification and security clearance by regional dealership directors.
